title: CODATA 2022: the deuteron-proton mass ratio is 1.999 007 501 2699
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 000 000 0084. A deuteron is not exactly two proton masses in this listing.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'deuteron-proton mass ratio 1.999 007 501 2699' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 0084'. The printed ratio is just under 2. This card reports that line. It does not interpret the difference as a binding energy, because the listing line does not say that.
